decisions.reason: As a hydraulic control component close to the firm's existing water-infrastructure know-how, it fits the installed knowledge base well, but as a newer niche hardware item with only limited website prominence it faces some portfolio rationalisation risk.

This energy management system builds directly on the firm's software, automation and infrastructure expertise and matches its strategic move toward digitally networked, efficient and energy-aware operations, so the firm is well placed to learn from and improve it.

The overflow flap gate is closely related to the firm's established water-level regulation business, and its dedicated product page suggests active commercial commitment, making withdrawal within a year relatively unlikely.
